rules.rule: Node sequence must match the declared template's node list (order, required, repeatable, body slot membership).
shell.footer is the last non-runtime node; only utility.page-transition / utility.preloader may follow it.
Exactly one hero.* node per page.
rules.exception: none: both templates have exactly one hero (templates/templates.json)

rules.rule: hero.home only on template.home; hero.case only on template.case-study.
At most one layout.gray-band per page (observed max 1 across 10 cases).
layout.gray-band must be followed by another body block: it positions itself from its next sibling.
utility.password-gate is present if and only if access = password-gated.
content.case-index-item indexes run 01, 02, ... in node order (zero-padded position).
A case body usually opens with content.media-text (9 of 10 cases; the gated case opens with content.text).
At most two physics-drop nodes per page (both templates use exactly two).
template.home uses theme dark; template.case-study uses theme light.
